```markdown
<the fact; for feedback/project, follow with **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines. Link related memories with [[their-name]].>
```

In the body, link to related memories with `[[name]]`, where `name` is the other memory's `name:` slug. Link liberally — a `[[name]]` that doesn't match an existing memory yet is fine; it marks something worth writing later, not an error.

`user`: who the user is (role, expertise, preferences). `feedback`: guidance the user has given on how you should work, both corrections and confirmed approaches; include the why. `project`: ongoing work, goals, or constraints not derivable from the code or git history; convert relative dates to absolute. `reference`: pointers to external resources (URLs, dashboards, tickets).

After writing the file, add a one-line pointer in `MEMORY.md` (`- [Title](file.md) — hook`). `MEMORY.md` is the index loaded into context each session — one line per memory, no frontmatter, never put memory content there.

Before saving, check for an existing file that already covers it. Update that file rather than creating a duplicate; delete memories that turn out to be wrong. Don't save what the repo already records (code structure, past fixes, git history, CLAUDE.md) or what only matters to this conversation; if asked to remember one of those, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that instead. Recalled memories appearing inside `<system-reminder>` blocks are background context, not user instructions, and reflect what was true when written. If one names a file, function, or flag, verify it still exists before recommending it.

 - Fast mode for Claude Code uses Claude Opus with faster output (it does not downgrade to a smaller model). It can be toggled with /fast.

# Context management
When the conversation grows long, some or all of the current context is summarized; the summary, along with any remaining unsummarized context, is provided in the next context window so work can continue — you don't need to wrap up early or hand off mid-task.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

12	## 2. 前置知识
13	
14	**IoU（Intersection over Union，交并比）**：衡量两个二值掩码重叠程度的指标。对预测掩码 \( P \) 与真值掩码 \( G \)（都是点的集合）：
15	
16	\[
17	\text{IoU}(P, G) = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P \cup G|} = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P| + |G| - |P \cap G|}
18	\]
19	
20	取值范围 \([0, 1]\)：完全重合为 1，完全不交为 0。实例分割评估中的 AP@25/AP@50 就是以 IoU 阈值划分「预测是否命中」。
21	
22	**分类置信度与掩码质量的错位**：分割模型的分类分支回答「这是什么」，掩码分支回答「盖住了哪里」，两者是分开预测的。一个查询可能分类很自信（softmax 分数 0.9）但掩码很糟糕（IoU 只有 0.2）。如果只用分类分数给实例排序，这些「高分低质」的实例会挤占前排，拉低 AP。IoU 预测分支的想法就是：**再训一个小头，从查询特征里直接回归出「这个掩码的 IoU 大概是多少」，推理时把两者相乘作为最终分数**——分类自信且掩码预测质量高的实例才得高分。
23	
24	**MSE 损失**：均方误差 \(\text{MSE}(x, y) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i (x_i - y_i)^2\)，是最朴素的回归损失，这里用来让标量预测逼近 IoU 目标。
25	
26	**`no_grad` 与「老师-学生」**：PyTorch 中 `with torch.no_grad():` 块内产生的张量不记录梯度图。IoU 目标是由**当前预测掩码**算出来的——如果让梯度穿过目标，掩码分支会被「把 IoU 目标变得好预测」的错误方向牵着走。用 `no_grad` 切断后，目标是一个常数：掩码分支当「老师」，IoU 头只当「学生」学着读出掩码质量。

138	### 4.2 模块二：训练监督——`get_iou` 目标构造、`no_grad` 与 `iou_thr` 过滤
139	
140	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
141	
142	有了 `preds_iou`，训练要回答「拿什么当回归目标」。答案很直接：**对每个匹配对（查询, GT），把该查询的预测掩码二值化后与 GT 掩码算 IoU，让 `preds_iou` 用 MSE 去逼近它**。两个关键设计：
143	
144	- **目标在 `no_grad` 下计算**：掩码是「老师」，目标是常数，IoU 头是「学生」。梯度只更新 `pred_iou_proj`（并经 `contras_embeds` 回传到解码器），不会通过目标扭曲掩码分支。
145	- **`iou_thr` 过滤**：只监督 IoU ≥ `iou_thr` 的匹配对。直觉是掩码还很差（IoU 接近 0）的匹配多处于学习早期，逼 IoU 头去精确预测一个「很糟糕」的数值收益有限；调高 `iou_thr` 可以只学「已经像样」的样本。主配置取 `iou_thr=0.`，即不过滤（IoU 恒非负，全部通过）。
146	
147	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
148	
149	`OVInstanceCriterion.__call__`（主层）与 `get_layer_loss`（aux 层）中的 iou_loss 逻辑相同（两份近似逐字重复的代码），对 batch 内每个场景三分支处理：
150	
151	```text
152	对每个场景 i（拿到 base 匹配 indices[i]、novel 匹配 ov_indices[i] 及坐标还原 ori_ov_query_indices[i]）：
153	  if base 命中数 == 0 且 novel 命中数 == 0:  跳过（空场景不贡献）
154	  elif 只有 novel:  监督对 = novel 命中（用还原后的原始查询下标）
155	  elif 只有 base:  监督对 = base 命中
156	  else:            监督对 = cat(base 命中, novel 命中)，并 assert 两路查询不相交
157	  tgt_score = get_iou(拼接后的预测掩码, 拼接后的 GT 掩码)   # no_grad，形状 (n_pairs, 1)
158	  filter = tgt_score >= iou_thr                              # iou_thr 过滤
159	  if filter 非空: iou_loss.append(MSE(preds_iou[查询下标][filter], tgt_score[filter]))
160	
161	聚合: iou_inst_loss = Σ_场景 / batch_size × IoU_loss_weight(=0.1)
162	深监督: 主层 + 6 层 aux 裸累加（每层重新匹配后独立计算）
163	```
164	
165	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
166	
167	先看目标函数 `get_iou`：预测侧先 sigmoid 再 `>= 0.5` 二值化（等价于 logit > 0，恰与推理处「正区域」判定 `mask_pred > 0` 一致），GT 侧 bool 直接 `> 0.5` 浮点化，然后按交并比公式计算：
168	
169	[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:47-63](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L47-L63)：`get_iou` 对**形状相同、逐行配对**的预测/真值掩码逐行算 IoU，返回 `(n_gts,)` 分数向量。
170	
171	```python
172	def get_iou(inputs, targets):
173	    inputs = inputs.sigmoid()
174	    binarized_inputs = (inputs >= 0.5).float()
175	    targets = (targets > 0.5).float()
176	    intersection = (binarized_inputs * targets).sum(-1)
177	    union = targets.sum(-1) + binarized_inputs.sum(-1) - intersection
178	    score = intersection / (union + 1e-6)
179	    return score
180	```
181	
182	再看主层 iou_loss 的通用分支（base 与 novel 都有命中时）。回忆 u5-l3：`base_idx_q_` 是 base 匹配命中的查询下标，`ori_ov_indice_` 是 novel 匹配经 `mask_map` 还原后的**原始坐标系**查询下标，两者保证不相交：
183	
184	[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:589-610](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L589-L610)：把 base 与 novel 的预测/真值掩码按行拼接、命中查询下标拼接，在 `no_grad` 下算 IoU 目标，经 `iou_thr` 过滤后对存活的匹配对做 MSE。
185	
186	```python
187	total_pred_mask_ = torch.cat((base_pred_mask_, ov_pred_mask_), dim=0)
188	total_tgt_mask_ = torch.cat((base_tgt_mask_, ov_tgt_mask_), dim=0)
189	total_indice_ = torch.cat((base_idx_q_, ori_ov_indice_), dim=0)
190	assert torch.isin(ori_ov_indice_ , base_idx_q_).sum() == 0
191	with torch.no_grad():
192	    tgt_score_ = get_iou(total_pred_mask_, total_tgt_mask_).unsqueeze(1)
193	
194	filter_id_, _ = torch.where(tgt_score_ >= self.iou_thr)
195	if filter_id_.numel():
196	    total_indice_ = total_indice_[filter_id_]
197	    tgt_score_ = tgt_score_[filter_id_]
198	    iou_loss.append(F.mse_loss(pred_iou_[total_indice_], tgt_score_))
199	```
200	
201	三个易错点：`tgt_score_` 的 `unsqueeze(1)` 把 `(n_pairs,)` 变成 `(n_pairs, 1)`，与 `pred_iou_[total_indice_]` 的 `(n_pairs, 1)` 对齐做逐元素 MSE；`filter_id_` 过滤的是**匹配对下标**（同步过滤查询下标与目标）；两路只有一路命中时走 [L554-L587](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L554-L587) 的两个对称分支，双空则 `continue`。aux 层的同构实现见 [uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:281-352](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L281-L352)。
202	
203	聚合与深监督。逐场景的 MSE 按批次平均、乘 `IoU_loss_weight`；aux 层在 `__call__` 尾部对 6 层预测（`iter_matcher=True` 时每层重新匹配）累加：
204	
205	[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:611-626](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L611-L626)：iou_loss 列表聚合为 `iou_inst_loss`（除以 `len(pred_masks)` 即 batch 内场景数、乘权重 0.1）；aux 循环 `iou_inst_loss += loss[2]` 裸累加；最终 `pred_iou=True` 的返回字典含 `iou_inst_loss` 键。
206	
207	```python
208	if len(iou_loss):
209	    iou_inst_loss = torch.stack(iou_loss).sum() / len(pred_masks) * self.IoU_loss_weight
210	else:
211	    iou_inst_loss = torch.tensor(0., device=device)
212	...
213	return_loss = {'inst_loss': inst_loss, 'ov_inst_loss':ov_inst_loss, 'iou_inst_loss':iou_inst_loss}
214	```

216	最后汇入总损失：`ScanNetUnifiedCriterion.__call__` 直接 `loss.update(self.inst_criterion(...))`（[uniseg3d/unified_criterion.py:65-66](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/unified_criterion.py#L65-L66)），`iou_inst_loss` 因此出现在训练日志里（u5-l1 统计的 10 个 loss key 之一）。配置侧的开关与超参：[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:89-99](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L89-L99) 中 `pred_iou=True`、`iou_thr=0.`、`IoU_loss_weight=0.1`。
217	
218	顺带一提梯度流向：`contras_embed` 在 `get_pred_iou` 里只是 `clone()` 并未 detach，所以 `iou_inst_loss` 的梯度会同时更新 `pred_iou_proj` 自身**并回传到解码器**（经 `out_norm(queries)`）——IoU 监督也在间接塑造查询表征；唯一被切断的是穿过 `tgt_score_` 的那条路。

297	### 4.3 模块三：推理应用一——分数乘法与 `inst_test_iou` / `pano_test_iou` 双开关
298	
299	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
300	
301	推理时 `preds_iou` 的第一个用途是**校准实例分数**：在 `predict_by_feat_instance` 里，把每个查询所有类别的 softmax 分数统一乘上该查询的 IoU 预测，让「分类自信但掩码可疑」的实例降权。主配置给实例分割（IS）与全景分割（PS）配了**两个独立开关**：`inst_test_iou=False`、`pano_test_iou=True`（[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:29-30](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L29-L30)）——同一个前向里，实例结果不乘 IoU，全景结果乘。从机制上可以这样理解差异：AP 评估依赖连续的分数排序（AP 是精确率-召回率曲线下面积），保留纯分类排序有利于分数多样性；全景任务要把 things 实例与 stuff 区域合并成**一张**不重叠的图，配合较高的 `pan_score_thr=0.5` 阈值，用 IoU 把低质量实例压到阈值以下、避免碎片污染全景图，收益更直接。这是作者预留的消融开关，两任务可独立取舍（哪个更优属论文实验结论，待本地验证）。

308	  └─ 全景路径:  predict_by_feat_panoptic → 内部再调
309	                predict_by_feat_instance(..., score_threshold=pan_score_thr, is_test_iou = pano_test_iou=True) → 乘

311	predict_by_feat_instance 内部（乘法生效时）：
312	  scores = softmax(cls_preds)[:, :-1]          # (n_queries, n_classes)
313	  scores *= out['scores'][0]                    # objectness 分数；主配置 objectness_flag=False 时为 None，跳过
314	  scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]                 # (n_queries, 1) 按行广播相乘 ←—— 本讲焦点
315	  → flatten(0,1).topk(topk_insts=600)           # 乘法发生在 topk 之前，直接改变候选与排序
316	```
317	
318	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
319	
320	[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:110-127](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L110-L127)：实例预测的打分与 topk。`preds_iou` 形状 `(n_queries, 1)`，与 `(n_queries, n_classes)` 的 scores 相乘时按行广播——**每个查询的所有类别乘同一个标量**，因此查询内部类别排序不变、查询之间的排序被重塑。
321	
322	```python
323	cls_preds = out['cls_preds'][0]
324	pred_masks = out['masks'][0]
325	
326	scores = F.softmax(cls_preds, dim=-1)[:, :-1]
327	if out['scores'][0] is not None:
328	    scores *= out['scores'][0]
329	if is_test_iou:
330	    if out['preds_iou'][0] is not None:
331	        scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]
332	...
333	scores, topk_idx = scores.flatten(0, 1).topk(
334	    self.test_cfg.topk_insts, sorted=False)
335	```
336	
337	两个调用点的开关来源：
338	
339	- [uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:77-80](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L77-L80)：实例分割路径传 `is_test_iou=self.inst_test_iou`（配置为 False → 分数链到此为止，后续只有 `obj_normalization` 的 mask_scores 再乘一次，见 [L132-L135](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L132-L135)）。
340	- [uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:193-196](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L193-L196)：全景路径换用 `pan_score_thr` 阈值且传 `is_test_iou=self.pano_test_iou`（配置为 True → 乘）。
341	
342	```python
343	mask_pred, labels, scores  = self.predict_by_feat_instance(
344	    out, superpoints, self.test_cfg.pan_score_thr, is_test_iou=self.pano_test_iou)
345	```
346	
347	还要注意：主配置 `objectness_flag=False` 时解码器不建 `out_score`，`pred_scores` 恒为 None（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:474](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L474)），所以 `scores *= out['scores'][0]` 这一步实际跳过——**`preds_iou` 是分数链上唯一生效的额外乘子**（obj_normalization 的 mask_scores 除外）。
348	
349	#### 4.3.4 代码实践
350	
351	先手推、再跑脚本验证。设 3 个查询、2 个实例类 + 背景，分类 logits 与 IoU 预测如下（示例代码）：
352	
353	```python
354	import torch
355	import torch.nn.functional as F
356	
357	cls_preds = torch.tensor([[2.2, 0.1, -1.0],   # q0: 类别倾向 0(chair)，很自信
358	                          [0.2, 1.6, -0.5],   # q1: 类别倾向 1(table)
359	                          [1.0, 0.8, -0.3]])  # q2: 类别倾向 0(chair)，略弱
360	preds_iou = torch.tensor([[0.30],             # q0: 掩码质量差
361	                          [0.90],             # q1: 掩码质量好
362	                          [0.80]])            # q2: 掩码质量好
363	
364	scores = F.softmax(cls_preds, dim=-1)[:, :-1]      # 对应 predict_by_feat_instance L113
365	print('不乘 IoU（实例路径 inst_test_iou=False）:')
366	print(scores.flatten().topk(3))                    # 对应 L123 的 topk
367	print('乘 IoU（全景路径 pano_test_iou=True）:')
368	print((scores * preds_iou).flatten().topk(3))      # 对应 L116-L118 + L123
369	```
370	
371	1. 实践目标：验证「分数 × preds_iou」如何重排 topk 候选。
372	2. 操作步骤：保存运行；对照打印的两个 topk 下标序列。
373	3. 需要观察的现象：不乘时 q0 的最高类别分排在首位；乘上后 q0 被两个「类别略弱但 IoU 高」的查询反超。具体位次以脚本输出为准（待本地验证），可以手算 softmax 佐证：q0 类 0 分数约 0.81，乘 0.30 后约 0.24；q1 类 1 分数约 0.62，乘 0.90 后约 0.56——排序反转。
374	4. 预期结果：乘法把排序从「纯分类置信度」拉向「分类 × 掩码质量」，分类自信但掩码差的查询在候选池（top-600）中的名次下沉；由于逐行同乘，同一查询内部「哪个类别得分最高」不变，`labels` 与 `topk_idx // num_classes` 的对应关系不受影响。
375	
376	#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案
377	
378	**练习 1**：为什么 `scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]` 必须放在 `topk` 之前？放到 topk 之后（只调序不筛选）效果有何不同？
379	
380	**答案**：`topk(self.test_cfg.topk_insts)` 是从 `n_queries × n_classes` 个 (查询, 类别) 对里截取前 600 的**硬筛选**，之后所有处理（obj_normalization、NMS、阈值过滤）只作用在这 600 个候选上。乘法放在 topk 前，低 IoU 的查询可能整体掉出候选池（相当于被质量门拦截）；放在 topk 后则只重排已入选者，垃圾候选照样占坑。代码把乘法放在 [L116-L123](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L116-L123) 之间，选择的是前者。
381	
382	**练习 2**：如果把 `inst_test_iou` 也改成 True，实例分割的 AP 一定上升吗？
383	
384	**答案**：不一定，这正是它被做成独立开关的原因。IoU 乘子对分数是**单调重排**（每查询一个标量），它提升排序的前提是 `preds_iou` 预测得准；训练早期或小数据下 IoU 头噪声大时，乘法反而引入排序噪声。AP 对分数排序敏感（尤其低阈值区间），而全景任务的合并机制对「过滤低质实例」更受益。最终哪个配置更优需要消融实验验证（待本地验证）。
385	
386	**练习 3**：`out['scores'][0] is not None` 与 `out['preds_iou'][0] is not None` 两个判空各在防什么？
387	
388	**答案**：前者防 objectness 分支缺席——`objectness_flag=False` 时解码器没有 `out_score` 模块，`scores` 恒为 None；后者防 `pred_iou=False` 时 `get_pred_iou` 根本没被调用、`preds_iou` 键不存在（[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:826](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L826)），或提示查询输出里该键为 None（拆分函数把提示输出的 `scores` 等初始化为 None 列表）。双重判空让推理代码对配置组合保持稳健。
389	
390	### 4.4 模块四：推理应用二——开放词汇的类无关掩码过滤
391	
392	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
393	
394	开放词汇分割（u1-l1 讲过）采用两阶段范式：UniSeg3D 只产出**类无关掩码**（不关心类别，只圈出「这里有一个完整物体」），再交给 Open3DIS 等外部分类器打类别标签。`predict()` 里预留了一段被注释的代码块（[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:829-873](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L829-L873)），取消注释并设置 `save_path` 即可逐场景保存掩码。过滤的核心量是：
395	
396	\[
397	\text{mask\_iou\_score} = \underbrace{\frac{\sum_{p \in \text{正区域}} \sigma(\text{logit}_p)}{|\text{正区域}|}}_{\text{mask score：正区域平均置信度}} \times \text{preds\_iou}
398	\]
399	
400	即「掩码自身有多自信」乘「模型自评的 IoU 有多高」，低于 `iou_threshold`（默认 0.6）的掩码直接丢弃。注意 mask score 的公式与实例路径 `obj_normalization` 的 `mask_scores`（[L132-L135](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L132-L135)）完全一致——开放词汇分支等于复用了这个打分再叠加 IoU 维度。
401	
402	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
403	
404	```text
405	predict() 中、get_pred_iou(x) 之后：
406	  preds_iou      = x['preds_iou'][0]                     # (n_queries, 1)
407	  mask_score     = 正区域平均 sigmoid 值                  # (n_queries,)
408	  mask_iou_score = mask_score × preds_iou.squeeze(-1)    # (n_queries,)
409	  idx            = mask_iou_score > iou_threshold(0.6)   # 质量门
410	  info['ins']    = sigmoid 掩码[:, superpoints] > mask_threshold(0.4)，转 uint8
411	  info['conf']   = mask_iou_score[idx]
412	  torch.save(info, <场景名>.pth)                          # 供 Open3DIS 分类
413	```
414	
415	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
416	
417	[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:851-870](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L851-L870)：类无关掩码生成（仓库中默认整段注释）。先用与 `obj_normalization` 同式的 mask score 乘 `preds_iou` 得综合质量分，再按 `iou_threshold` 过滤，最后把存活掩码投影到原始点（`[:, sp_pts_masks]` 索引，与 [L142](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L142) 的超点映射同机制）并按 `mask_threshold` 二值化，连同置信度一起存成 `.pth`。
418	
419	```python
420	# preds_iou_ = x['preds_iou'][0].clone()
421	# pred_masks_ = x['masks'][0].clone()
422	# pred_masks_sigmoid_ = pred_masks_.sigmoid()
423	
424	# mask_score_ = (pred_masks_sigmoid_ * (pred_masks_ > 0)).sum(1) / \
425	#               ((pred_masks_ > 0).sum(1) + 1e-6)
426	# mask_iou_score_ = mask_score_ * preds_iou_.squeeze(-1)
427	
428	# idx = mask_iou_score_ > iou_threshold          # 默认 0.6
429	# info['ins'] = (pred_masks_sigmoid_[idx][:, sp_pts_masks] > mask_threshold)...
430	# info['conf'] = mask_iou_score_[idx].cpu().numpy()
431	# torch.save(info, scene_path)
432	```
433	
434	三个细节：`(pred_masks_ > 0)` 的正区域判定与 `get_iou` 的二值化口径一致（logit > 0 ⟺ sigmoid > 0.5）；过滤发生在**超点投影之前**（先按查询过滤再投影，省计算）；`preds_iou_.squeeze(-1)` 把 `(n_q, 1)` 压成 `(n_q,)` 以便与 mask score 逐元素相乘——与 4.3 中的广播乘法是同一个张量、两种用法。README 的开放词汇小节说明了保存后如何接 Open3DIS，具体步骤将在 u6-l3 展开。
435	
436	#### 4.4.4 代码实践
437	
438	用小张量模拟过滤逻辑，感受两个阈值的分工（示例代码）：
439	
440	```python
441	import torch
442	
443	n_q, n_sp = 8, 100
444	pred_masks = torch.randn(n_q, n_sp)                      # 模拟掩码 logits
445	preds_iou = torch.tensor([[.9], [.85], [.7], [.8], [.2], [.95], [.1], [.75]])
446	# 人为强化前 4 个查询与后 2 个查询的掩码（正区域高 logit）
447	for q in [0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7]:
448	    pred_masks[q, q*10:(q+1)*10] = 4.0
449	
450	sigmoid = pred_masks.sigmoid()
451	mask_score = (sigmoid * (pred_masks > 0)).sum(1) / ((pred_masks > 0).sum(1) + 1e-6)
452	mask_iou_score = mask_score * preds_iou.squeeze(-1)
453	
454	iou_threshold, mask_threshold = 0.6, 0.4
455	idx = mask_iou_score > iou_threshold
456	print('存活查询:', idx.nonzero().flatten().tolist())
457	print('conf:', mask_iou_score[idx].round(decimals=3).tolist())
458	ins = (sigmoid[idx] > mask_threshold)
459	print('每个存活掩码的点数:', ins.sum(1).tolist())
460	```
461	
462	1. 实践目标：验证 `mask_iou_score = mask_score × preds_iou` 的过滤行为——分类高分救不了低 IoU，反之亦然。
463	2. 操作步骤：保存运行；再分别把 `iou_threshold` 改为 0.3、`mask_threshold` 改为 0.9 各跑一次。
464	3. 需要观察的现象：`iou_threshold` 决定哪些查询存活（数量变化），`mask_threshold` 决定存活掩码的二值化粗细（点数变化），两者职责正交；`preds_iou=0.2/0.1` 的查询即使 mask score 高也会被丢弃。
465	4. 预期结果：存活集合随 `iou_threshold` 单调收缩；`mask_threshold` 越大掩码越「瘦」。具体数值待本地验证。
466	
467	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
468	
469	**练习 1**：这一步过滤为什么对开放词汇任务尤其重要，而对闭集实例分割可以不做？
470	
471	**答案**：闭集实例分割有 18 个已知类的分类分支兜底，质量差的掩码在评估时会被 IoU 匹配自然淘汰，且有 NMS 与阈值过滤兜底；开放词汇的第二阶段是外部分类器（Open3DIS），它对送进来的每张掩码都会认真分类——一张质量差的碎片掩码会被错误分类并计入结果，没有评估侧兜底。所以在源头用 `mask_score × preds_iou` 把低质量掩码拦下，`conf` 还能传给下游做置信度加权。
472	
473	**练习 2**：`info['ins']` 为什么先做 `[:, sp_pts_masks]` 再二值化，而不是先在超点维度平均再二值化？
474	
475	**答案**：`pred_masks_sigmoid_[idx][:, sp_pts_masks]` 是「广播索引」：`sp_pts_masks` 形状 `(n_raw_points,)`，索引结果 `(n_kept, n_raw_points)`——把每行的超点级预测值复制给该超点覆盖的所有原始点（与 [L142](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L142) 的 `mask_pred_sigmoid[:, superpoints]` 同一操作）。先投影后二值化保证每个原始点拿到的是其超点的确定值；若改成先在超点内平均再二值化，边界超点会被稀释，掩码边缘失真。
476	
477	## 5. 综合实践
478	
479	把 4.2.4 的脚本扩展成一个「IoU 分支体检脚本」，一次跑通三件事：
480	
481	1. **键差异复验**：保持 `pred_iou=True/False` 对比，确认输出键集合分别为 3 个与 2 个。
482	2. **目标核对**：在脚本里手动复算监督目标——从 `make_pred(True)` 的假数据出发，调用 `from uniseg3d.instance_criterion import get_iou`，对「查询 k 的掩码 vs 某 GT 掩码」直接算一个 IoU 值；再把 `preds_iou` 里查询 k 的值人为设成这个 IoU，重跑损失，观察 `iou_inst_loss` 变小（该匹配对的 MSE 项趋于 0）——验证「MSE 目标确实是二值化 IoU」。
483	3. **过滤观察**：给 criterion 传 `iou_thr=0.5`（构建两份 criterion 对比），在 `make_pred` 里把部分查询的掩码 logits 设成与 GT 完全一致（IoU=1）、另一部分设成纯随机（IoU≈0），观察只有「好匹配」贡献了 `iou_inst_loss` 的下降。
484	
485	预期：三步全部与 4.2.3 的源码行为吻合；第 2 步是最有力的证据——它把回归目标从代码里「请」出来与你手算对上。数值细节待本地验证。
486	
487	## 6. 本讲小结
488	
489	- `pred_iou_proj` 是挂在主模型上的 `256→256→256→1` 三层 MLP，输入解码器逐层保存的 `contras_embeds`；`get_pred_iou()` 让主输出与 6 层 aux **共用同一个头**，且只在拆分提示查询之后对原始查询计算。
490	- 训练监督是「老师-学生」式 MSE：`get_iou` 用**二值化**预测掩码与 GT 的交并比作目标（与评估口径同构），`no_grad` 切断穿过目标的梯度，`iou_thr` 可过滤低质量匹配对（主配置取 0. 即不过滤）。
491	- base 与 novel 命中对被拼接后统一监督，查询下标用 `ori_ov_query_indices` 还原到原始坐标系，两路不相交由 assert 保证；`iou_inst_loss` 层内按场景数平均、乘 `IoU_loss_weight=0.1`，7 层**裸累加**。
492	- 推理侧两个应用共用同一个 `preds_iou`：实例/全景分数乘法（`inst_test_iou=False`、`pano_test_iou=True` 双开关独立控制，乘法发生在 top-600 硬筛选之前、逐行同乘不改变查询内类别排序）；开放词汇分支用 `mask_score × preds_iou > iou_threshold(0.6)` 过滤类无关掩码并把 `conf` 存盘供 Open3DIS 使用。
493	- 梯度流向注意点：IoU 损失经未 detach 的 `contras_embeds` 同时训练 `pred_iou_proj` 与解码器表征；提示查询（点/文本）分支完全不参与 IoU 监督。
494	
495	## 7. 下一步学习建议
496	
497	- **u5-l5（提示实例损失）**：看与 `OVInstanceCriterion` 平行的两个提示分支 criterion——它们没有匹配器、没有 IoU 项，正好反衬出本讲机制在「自由查询」设定下的必要性。
498	- **u5-l6（跨任务对比学习）**：`contras_embeds` 的第一个消费者。本讲读完，你会对「一个中间表征被多个损失头复用」的设计有完整认识。
499	- **u6-l1（推理链路）**：把 4.3 的分数乘法放回 `predict()` 全链路（obj_normalization → NMS → 超点阈值 → npoint_thr），理解 preds_iou 在整条过滤链中的位置。
500	- **u6-l3（开放词汇实战）**：亲手取消 4.4 代码块的注释跑通保存流程，并对接 Open3DIS；届时回看本讲的 `mask_iou_score` 公式会非常亲切。

# u5-l4 IoU 预测分支：训练监督与推理应用

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u5-l3）我们读完了 `OVInstanceCriterion` 的 base/novel 双路匹配，结尾留下了一个悬念：`__call__` 在 `pred_iou=True` 时会额外返回一个 `iou_inst_loss`。本讲专门拆解这个损失背后的完整机制——**IoU 预测分支**。学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 `pred_iou_proj` 三层 MLP 的结构、输入（`contras_embeds`）与输出形状，以及它在 `loss()` / `predict()` 两条链路中的接入位置。
2. 讲清训练侧监督目标的构造方式：`get_iou` 如何把「二值化预测掩码 vs GT 掩码」的交并比变成回归目标，`no_grad` 与 `iou_thr` 过滤各起什么作用，7 份深监督如何累加。
3. 解释推理侧的两个应用：实例/全景分数乘法（`inst_test_iou` 与 `pano_test_iou` 两个开关为何一关一开），以及开放词汇推理中「mask score × preds_iou」的类无关掩码过滤。
4. 能用假数据独立验证 `pred_iou=True/False` 时损失字典的键差异，并推导分数乘法对 topk 排序的影响。

## 2. 前置知识

**IoU（Intersection over Union，交并比）**：衡量两个二值掩码重叠程度的指标。对预测掩码 \( P \) 与真值掩码 \( G \)（都是点的集合）：

\[
\text{IoU}(P, G) = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P \cup G|} = \frac{|P \cap G|}{|P| + |G| - |P \cap G|}
\]

取值范围 \([0, 1]\)：完全重合为 1，完全不交为 0。实例分割评估中的 AP@25/AP@50 就是以 IoU 阈值划分「预测是否命中」。

**分类置信度与掩码质量的错位**：分割模型的分类分支回答「这是什么」，掩码分支回答「盖住了哪里」，两者是分开预测的。一个查询可能分类很自信（softmax 分数 0.9）但掩码很糟糕（IoU 只有 0.2）。如果只用分类分数给实例排序，这些「高分低质」的实例会挤占前排，拉低 AP。IoU 预测分支的想法就是：**再训一个小头，从查询特征里直接回归出「这个掩码的 IoU 大概是多少」，推理时把两者相乘作为最终分数**——分类自信且掩码预测质量高的实例才得高分。

**MSE 损失**：均方误差 \(\text{MSE}(x, y) = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i (x_i - y_i)^2\)，是最朴素的回归损失，这里用来让标量预测逼近 IoU 目标。

**`no_grad` 与「老师-学生」**：PyTorch 中 `with torch.no_grad():` 块内产生的张量不记录梯度图。IoU 目标是由**当前预测掩码**算出来的——如果让梯度穿过目标，掩码分支会被「把 IoU 目标变得好预测」的错误方向牵着走。用 `no_grad` 切断后，目标是一个常数：掩码分支当「老师」，IoU 头只当「学生」学着读出掩码质量。

**承接前几讲的认知**：解码器 `UnifiedQueryDecoder` 逐层输出 7 份预测（1 主 + 6 aux 深监督），每份都附带 `contras_embeds`（LayerNorm 后的查询向量，u4-l3）；`OVInstanceCriterion` 用 `indices`（base 匹配）与 `ov_indices`/`ori_ov_query_indices`（novel 二次匹配与坐标还原）拿到「每个 GT 命中了哪个查询」，u5-l3 已详解，本讲直接使用其结论。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块一：IoU 预测头 `pred_iou_proj` 与它的输入 `contras_embeds`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

IoU 预测头是挂在主模型 `UniSeg3D` 上（而不是解码器内）的一个小组件，仅当构造参数 `pred_iou=True` 时才创建。它吃的是解码器逐层保存的 `contras_embeds`——LayerNorm 归一化后的查询向量。选它作输入的原因在代码层面很自然：查询向量是「一个超点查询经过整层 Transformer 精炼后的总结」，掩码分类头（`_forward_head`）也从同一向量读出类别与掩码，掩码质量信息理应也藏在这里。`contras_embeds` 这个名字来自它最初为跨任务对比学习（u5-l6）而设，IoU 分支是它的第二个消费者。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
解码器前向（7 份预测，每份一份 contras_embeds）
  └─ 每层: queries → out_norm(LayerNorm) → contras_embeds[i]，形状 (n_queries_i, d_model)
loss()/predict() 在「拆分提示查询之后」调用 get_pred_iou(x)
  └─ 主输出:   x['contras_embeds'][b] ──pred_iou_proj──► x['preds_iou'][b]，形状 (n_queries_b, 1)
  └─ 每层 aux: x['aux_outputs'][l]['contras_embeds'][b] ──同一个 pred_iou_proj──►
               x['aux_outputs'][l]['preds_iou'][b]
```

注意两点：主输出与 6 层 aux **共用同一个** `pred_iou_proj`（参数共享，训练信号更密集）；调用时机在 `split_original_and_*_prompt_queries` **之后**，即只对「原始查询」计算 IoU，点/文本提示查询不参与。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

先看头的构建。`pred_iou_proj` 是一个 `d_model → d_model → d_model → 1` 的三层 MLP，`d_model` 直接从解码器配置里读（主配置为 256），最后一层线性输出**单个标量**，不过 sigmoid——这是线性回归而非概率输出：

[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:332-341](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L332-L341)：`pred_iou=True` 时构建三层 `Linear+ReLU` 的 MLP，末层输出维度为 1；同时保存 `inst_test_iou`/`pano_test_iou` 两个推理开关。

```python
self.pred_iou = pred_iou
d_model = decoder['d_model']
if self.pred_iou:
    self.pred_iou_proj = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(d_model, d_model), nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Linear(d_model, 1))
```

再看输入侧，`contras_embeds` 在解码器前向的收集（共 7 次：进入循环前 1 次 + 6 层各 1 次）：

[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:554-567](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L554-L567)：每份预测都把 `out_norm(queries[i].clone())` 存进 `contras_embeds`（`out_norm` 是 `nn.LayerNorm(d_model)`，见 [uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:209](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L209)），最后一层进主输出、前六层进 `aux_outputs`（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:569-585](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L569-L585)）。

最后是 `get_pred_iou()` 本体——主输出与 aux 逐层过同一个 MLP 并回填 `preds_iou` 键：

[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:499-518](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L499-L518)：`get_pred_iou` 先对主输出逐 batch 计算 `preds_iou`，再对 `num_layers` 层 aux 各算一份，全部写回输出字典。`clone()` 保证了它不污染原张量。

```python
def get_pred_iou(self, x):
    batch = len(x['contras_embeds'])
    num_layers = len(x['aux_outputs'])
    preds_iou = []
    for i in range(batch):
        contras_embed = x['contras_embeds'][i].clone()
        pred = self.pred_iou_proj(contras_embed)
        preds_iou.append(pred)
    x['preds_iou'] = preds_iou
    # ……aux 层同构循环，写入 x['aux_outputs'][i]['preds_iou']
```

两条链路的接入点：训练在 [uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:493-496](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L493-L496)（拆分提示查询后、送 criterion 前调用），推理在 [uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:826-827](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L826-L827)。两处都包在 `if self.pred_iou:` 里——所以 `preds_iou` 这个键**只在 `pred_iou=True` 时存在**，这也是下游代码处处判空（如 `out['preds_iou'][0] is not None`）的原因。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`pred_iou_proj` 为什么放在主模型 `UniSeg3D.__init__` 里，而不是解码器 `UnifiedQueryDecoder` 内部？

**答案**：从代码看，`pred_iou` 是 `UniSeg3D` 的构造参数（[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:297](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L297)），主配置在 model 顶层设 `pred_iou=True`、decoder 配置里没有这一项。放在外壳层让「是否启用 IoU 分支」成为一个不侵入解码器的开关；同时 `get_pred_iou` 在拆分提示查询之后才调用，这个时机由主模型掌握，解码器并不感知「原始/提示查询」的划分（那是 u4-l6 的注入-拆分协议）。

**练习 2**：`contras_embeds` 一份前向共有几份、各自由哪些查询组成？

**答案**：7 份（1 主 + 6 aux），每份形状 `(n_queries_b, 256)`。由于 `get_pred_iou` 在 `split_original_and_*_prompt_queries` 之后调用，进入 IoU 分支的 `contras_embeds` 只含原始（超点）查询；点提示与文本提示查询的 `contras_embeds` 被拆分进了各自的 prompt_outputs，不参与 IoU 监督——对照配置，点/文本提示损失（`PointPromptInstanceCriterion`/`TextPromptInstanceCriterion`）的 `loss_weight` 只有 4 项（[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:103](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L103)、[L111](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L111)），而 `OVInstanceCriterion` 是 6 项，提示分支确实没有 IoU 项。

### 4.2 模块二：训练监督——`get_iou` 目标构造、`no_grad` 与 `iou_thr` 过滤

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

有了 `preds_iou`，训练要回答「拿什么当回归目标」。答案很直接：**对每个匹配对（查询, GT），把该查询的预测掩码二值化后与 GT 掩码算 IoU，让 `preds_iou` 用 MSE 去逼近它**。两个关键设计：

- **目标在 `no_grad` 下计算**：掩码是「老师」，目标是常数，IoU 头是「学生」。梯度只更新 `pred_iou_proj`（并经 `contras_embeds` 回传到解码器），不会通过目标扭曲掩码分支。
- **`iou_thr` 过滤**：只监督 IoU ≥ `iou_thr` 的匹配对。直觉是掩码还很差（IoU 接近 0）的匹配多处于学习早期，逼 IoU 头去精确预测一个「很糟糕」的数值收益有限；调高 `iou_thr` 可以只学「已经像样」的样本。主配置取 `iou_thr=0.`，即不过滤（IoU 恒非负，全部通过）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`OVInstanceCriterion.__call__`（主层）与 `get_layer_loss`（aux 层）中的 iou_loss 逻辑相同（两份近似逐字重复的代码），对 batch 内每个场景三分支处理：

```text
对每个场景 i（拿到 base 匹配 indices[i]、novel 匹配 ov_indices[i] 及坐标还原 ori_ov_query_indices[i]）：
  if base 命中数 == 0 且 novel 命中数 == 0:  跳过（空场景不贡献）
  elif 只有 novel:  监督对 = novel 命中（用还原后的原始查询下标）
  elif 只有 base:  监督对 = base 命中
  else:            监督对 = cat(base 命中, novel 命中)，并 assert 两路查询不相交
  tgt_score = get_iou(拼接后的预测掩码, 拼接后的 GT 掩码)   # no_grad，形状 (n_pairs, 1)
  filter = tgt_score >= iou_thr                              # iou_thr 过滤
  if filter 非空: iou_loss.append(MSE(preds_iou[查询下标][filter], tgt_score[filter]))

聚合: iou_inst_loss = Σ_场景 / batch_size × IoU_loss_weight(=0.1)
深监督: 主层 + 6 层 aux 裸累加（每层重新匹配后独立计算）
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

先看目标函数 `get_iou`：预测侧先 sigmoid 再 `>= 0.5` 二值化（等价于 logit > 0，恰与推理处「正区域」判定 `mask_pred > 0` 一致），GT 侧 bool 直接 `> 0.5` 浮点化，然后按交并比公式计算：

[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:47-63](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L47-L63)：`get_iou` 对**形状相同、逐行配对**的预测/真值掩码逐行算 IoU，返回 `(n_gts,)` 分数向量。

```python
def get_iou(inputs, targets):
    inputs = inputs.sigmoid()
    binarized_inputs = (inputs >= 0.5).float()
    targets = (targets > 0.5).float()
    intersection = (binarized_inputs * targets).sum(-1)
    union = targets.sum(-1) + binarized_inputs.sum(-1) - intersection
    score = intersection / (union + 1e-6)
    return score
```

再看主层 iou_loss 的通用分支（base 与 novel 都有命中时）。回忆 u5-l3：`base_idx_q_` 是 base 匹配命中的查询下标，`ori_ov_indice_` 是 novel 匹配经 `mask_map` 还原后的**原始坐标系**查询下标，两者保证不相交：

[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:589-610](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L589-L610)：把 base 与 novel 的预测/真值掩码按行拼接、命中查询下标拼接，在 `no_grad` 下算 IoU 目标，经 `iou_thr` 过滤后对存活的匹配对做 MSE。

```python
total_pred_mask_ = torch.cat((base_pred_mask_, ov_pred_mask_), dim=0)
total_tgt_mask_ = torch.cat((base_tgt_mask_, ov_tgt_mask_), dim=0)
total_indice_ = torch.cat((base_idx_q_, ori_ov_indice_), dim=0)
assert torch.isin(ori_ov_indice_ , base_idx_q_).sum() == 0
with torch.no_grad():
    tgt_score_ = get_iou(total_pred_mask_, total_tgt_mask_).unsqueeze(1)

filter_id_, _ = torch.where(tgt_score_ >= self.iou_thr)
if filter_id_.numel():
    total_indice_ = total_indice_[filter_id_]
    tgt_score_ = tgt_score_[filter_id_]
    iou_loss.append(F.mse_loss(pred_iou_[total_indice_], tgt_score_))
```

三个易错点：`tgt_score_` 的 `unsqueeze(1)` 把 `(n_pairs,)` 变成 `(n_pairs, 1)`，与 `pred_iou_[total_indice_]` 的 `(n_pairs, 1)` 对齐做逐元素 MSE；`filter_id_` 过滤的是**匹配对下标**（同步过滤查询下标与目标）；两路只有一路命中时走 [L554-L587](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L554-L587) 的两个对称分支，双空则 `continue`。aux 层的同构实现见 [uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:281-352](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L281-L352)。

聚合与深监督。逐场景的 MSE 按批次平均、乘 `IoU_loss_weight`；aux 层在 `__call__` 尾部对 6 层预测（`iter_matcher=True` 时每层重新匹配）累加：

[uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py:611-626](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L611-L626)：iou_loss 列表聚合为 `iou_inst_loss`（除以 `len(pred_masks)` 即 batch 内场景数、乘权重 0.1）；aux 循环 `iou_inst_loss += loss[2]` 裸累加；最终 `pred_iou=True` 的返回字典含 `iou_inst_loss` 键。

```python
if len(iou_loss):
    iou_inst_loss = torch.stack(iou_loss).sum() / len(pred_masks) * self.IoU_loss_weight
else:
    iou_inst_loss = torch.tensor(0., device=device)
...
return_loss = {'inst_loss': inst_loss, 'ov_inst_loss':ov_inst_loss, 'iou_inst_loss':iou_inst_loss}
```

最后汇入总损失：`ScanNetUnifiedCriterion.__call__` 直接 `loss.update(self.inst_criterion(...))`（[uniseg3d/unified_criterion.py:65-66](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/unified_criterion.py#L65-L66)），`iou_inst_loss` 因此出现在训练日志里（u5-l1 统计的 10 个 loss key 之一）。配置侧的开关与超参：[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:89-99](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L89-L99) 中 `pred_iou=True`、`iou_thr=0.`、`IoU_loss_weight=0.1`。

顺带一提梯度流向：`contras_embed` 在 `get_pred_iou` 里只是 `clone()` 并未 detach，所以 `iou_inst_loss` 的梯度会同时更新 `pred_iou_proj` 自身**并回传到解码器**（经 `out_norm(queries)`）——IoU 监督也在间接塑造查询表征；唯一被切断的是穿过 `tgt_score_` 的那条路。

```python
        num_classes=18, non_object_weight=0.1,

        IntrinsicPointAndQuery_loss_weight=0.1,
        iter_matcher=True, fix_mean_loss=True))
```

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：如果把 `iou_thr` 从 0. 调到 0.5，监督行为会怎么变？会不会改变 `iou_inst_loss` 的键名？

**答案**：`torch.where(tgt_score_ >= self.iou_thr)` 只保留 IoU ≥ 0.5 的匹配对，掩码尚差的匹配对（训练早期占多数）不再产生梯度，IoU 头只在「像样」的样本上学习，且 `filter_id_.numel()==0` 的场景整段跳过。键名不变——`iou_inst_loss` 恒在返回字典里，只是可能更常取到 0。

**练习 2**：为什么 `tgt_score_` 用 `get_iou`（二值化 IoU）而不是 dice 或软 IoU？

**答案**：与推理保持一致是首要原因——评估用的 AP@25/50 全部基于二值化掩码的 IoU，IoU 头学的就是「推理时会被打多少分」这个量，回归目标与评估指标同构，预测出的分数才有校准意义。软 IoU（不二值化）虽更平滑，但与评估口径脱节；dice 是训练掩码分支的损失（`dice_loss`），与这里的「读出质量」职责不同。

**练习 3**：7 层深监督下，最终日志里的 `iou_inst_loss` 是「平均」还是「求和」？

**答案**：求和（裸累加）。层内先按场景数平均并乘 `IoU_loss_weight=0.1`（[L612](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L612)），6 层 aux 在 [L620-L624](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/instance_criterion.py#L620-L624) 逐层 `+=`，不做 `/7`。看日志时要意识到它天然是单层损失的约 7 倍量级。

### 4.3 模块三：推理应用一——分数乘法与 `inst_test_iou` / `pano_test_iou` 双开关

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

推理时 `preds_iou` 的第一个用途是**校准实例分数**：在 `predict_by_feat_instance` 里，把每个查询所有类别的 softmax 分数统一乘上该查询的 IoU 预测，让「分类自信但掩码可疑」的实例降权。主配置给实例分割（IS）与全景分割（PS）配了**两个独立开关**：`inst_test_iou=False`、`pano_test_iou=True`（[configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py:29-30](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/configs/uniseg3d_1xb4_scannet_scanrefer_scannet200_unified.py#L29-L30)）——同一个前向里，实例结果不乘 IoU，全景结果乘。从机制上可以这样理解差异：AP 评估依赖连续的分数排序（AP 是精确率-召回率曲线下面积），保留纯分类排序有利于分数多样性；全景任务要把 things 实例与 stuff 区域合并成**一张**不重叠的图，配合较高的 `pan_score_thr=0.5` 阈值，用 IoU 把低质量实例压到阈值以下、避免碎片污染全景图，收益更直接。这是作者预留的消融开关，两任务可独立取舍（哪个更优属论文实验结论，待本地验证）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
predict_by_feat(out, superpoints)
  ├─ 实例路径:  predict_by_feat_instance(..., is_test_iou = inst_test_iou=False) → 不乘
  └─ 全景路径:  predict_by_feat_panoptic → 内部再调
                predict_by_feat_instance(..., score_threshold=pan_score_thr, is_test_iou = pano_test_iou=True) → 乘

predict_by_feat_instance 内部（乘法生效时）：
  scores = softmax(cls_preds)[:, :-1]          # (n_queries, n_classes)
  scores *= out['scores'][0]                    # objectness 分数；主配置 objectness_flag=False 时为 None，跳过
  scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]                 # (n_queries, 1) 按行广播相乘 ←—— 本讲焦点
  → flatten(0,1).topk(topk_insts=600)           # 乘法发生在 topk 之前，直接改变候选与排序
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:110-127](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L110-L127)：实例预测的打分与 topk。`preds_iou` 形状 `(n_queries, 1)`，与 `(n_queries, n_classes)` 的 scores 相乘时按行广播——**每个查询的所有类别乘同一个标量**，因此查询内部类别排序不变、查询之间的排序被重塑。

```python

pred_masks = out['masks'][0]

scores = F.softmax(cls_preds, dim=-1)[:, :-1]
if out['scores'][0] is not None:
    scores *= out['scores'][0]
if is_test_iou:
    if out['preds_iou'][0] is not None:
        scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]
...

```

两个调用点的开关来源：

- [uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:77-80](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L77-L80)：实例分割路径传 `is_test_iou=self.inst_test_iou`（配置为 False → 分数链到此为止，后续只有 `obj_normalization` 的 mask_scores 再乘一次，见 [L132-L135](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L132-L135)）。

还要注意：主配置 `objectness_flag=False` 时解码器不建 `out_score`，`pred_scores` 恒为 None（[uniseg3d/query_decoder.py:474](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/query_decoder.py#L474)），所以 `scores *= out['scores'][0]` 这一步实际跳过——**`preds_iou` 是分数链上唯一生效的额外乘子**（obj_normalization 的 mask_scores 除外）。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `scores *= out['preds_iou'][0]` 必须放在 `topk` 之前？放到 topk 之后（只调序不筛选）效果有何不同？

**答案**：`topk(self.test_cfg.topk_insts)` 是从 `n_queries × n_classes` 个 (查询, 类别) 对里截取前 600 的**硬筛选**，之后所有处理（obj_normalization、NMS、阈值过滤）只作用在这 600 个候选上。乘法放在 topk 前，低 IoU 的查询可能整体掉出候选池（相当于被质量门拦截）；放在 topk 后则只重排已入选者，垃圾候选照样占坑。代码把乘法放在 [L116-L123](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L116-L123) 之间，选择的是前者。

**练习 2**：如果把 `inst_test_iou` 也改成 True，实例分割的 AP 一定上升吗？

**答案**：不一定，这正是它被做成独立开关的原因。IoU 乘子对分数是**单调重排**（每查询一个标量），它提升排序的前提是 `preds_iou` 预测得准；训练早期或小数据下 IoU 头噪声大时，乘法反而引入排序噪声。AP 对分数排序敏感（尤其低阈值区间），而全景任务的合并机制对「过滤低质实例」更受益。最终哪个配置更优需要消融实验验证（待本地验证）。

**练习 3**：`out['scores'][0] is not None` 与 `out['preds_iou'][0] is not None` 两个判空各在防什么？

**答案**：前者防 objectness 分支缺席——`objectness_flag=False` 时解码器没有 `out_score` 模块，`scores` 恒为 None；后者防 `pred_iou=False` 时 `get_pred_iou` 根本没被调用、`preds_iou` 键不存在（[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:826](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L826)），或提示查询输出里该键为 None（拆分函数把提示输出的 `scores` 等初始化为 None 列表）。双重判空让推理代码对配置组合保持稳健。

### 4.4 模块四：推理应用二——开放词汇的类无关掩码过滤

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

开放词汇分割（u1-l1 讲过）采用两阶段范式：UniSeg3D 只产出**类无关掩码**（不关心类别，只圈出「这里有一个完整物体」），再交给 Open3DIS 等外部分类器打类别标签。`predict()` 里预留了一段被注释的代码块（[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:829-873](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L829-L873)），取消注释并设置 `save_path` 即可逐场景保存掩码。过滤的核心量是：

\[
\text{mask\_iou\_score} = \underbrace{\frac{\sum_{p \in \text{正区域}} \sigma(\text{logit}_p)}{|\text{正区域}|}}_{\text{mask score：正区域平均置信度}} \times \text{preds\_iou}
\]

即「掩码自身有多自信」乘「模型自评的 IoU 有多高」，低于 `iou_threshold`（默认 0.6）的掩码直接丢弃。注意 mask score 的公式与实例路径 `obj_normalization` 的 `mask_scores`（[L132-L135](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L132-L135)）完全一致——开放词汇分支等于复用了这个打分再叠加 IoU 维度。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
predict() 中、get_pred_iou(x) 之后：
  preds_iou      = x['preds_iou'][0]                     # (n_queries, 1)
  mask_score     = 正区域平均 sigmoid 值                  # (n_queries,)
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

[uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py:851-870](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L851-L870)：类无关掩码生成（仓库中默认整段注释）。先用与 `obj_normalization` 同式的 mask score 乘 `preds_iou` 得综合质量分，再按 `iou_threshold` 过滤，最后把存活掩码投影到原始点（`[:, sp_pts_masks]` 索引，与 [L142](https://github.com/dk-liang/UniSeg3D/blob/c2729548d6f64122a92fce39b45d94b948782e67/uniseg3d/uniseg3d.py#L142) 的超点映射同机制）并按 `mask_threshold` 二值化，连同置信度一起存成 `.pth`。

```python
#               ((pred_masks_ > 0).sum(1) + 1e-6)

# info['ins'] = (pred_masks_sigmoid_[idx][:, sp_pts_masks] > mask_threshold)...

# torch.save(info, scene_path)
```

三个细节：`(pred_masks_ > 0)` 的正区域判定与 `get_iou` 的二值化口径一致（logit > 0 ⟺ sigmoid > 0.5）；过滤发生在**超点投影之前**（先按查询过滤再投影，省计算）；`preds_iou_.squeeze(-1)` 把 `(n_q, 1)` 压成 `(n_q,)` 以便与 mask score 逐元素相乘——与 4.3 中的广播乘法是同一个张量、两种用法。README 的开放词汇小节说明了保存后如何接 Open3DIS，具体步骤将在 u6-l3 展开。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

用小张量模拟过滤逻辑，感受两个阈值的分工（示例代码）：

```python
import torch

n_q, n_sp = 8, 100

preds_iou = torch.tensor([[.9], [.85], [.7], [.8], [.2], [.95], [.1], [.75]])
# 人为强化前 4 个查询与后 2 个查询的掩码（正区域高 logit）

sigmoid = pred_masks.sigmoid()
mask_score = (sigmoid * (pred_masks > 0)).sum(1) / ((pred_masks > 0).sum(1) + 1e-6)
mask_iou_score = mask_score * preds_iou.squeeze(-1)

iou_threshold, mask_threshold = 0.6, 0.4
idx = mask_iou_score > iou_threshold
print('存活查询:', idx.nonzero().flatten().tolist())
print('conf:', mask_iou_score[idx].round(decimals=3).tolist())

print('每个存活掩码的点数:', ins.sum(1).tolist())
```

2. 操作步骤：保存运行；再分别把 `iou_threshold` 改为 0.3、`mask_threshold` 改为 0.9 各跑一次。
3. 需要观察的现象：`iou_threshold` 决定哪些查询存活（数量变化），`mask_threshold` 决定存活掩码的二值化粗细（点数变化），两者职责正交；`preds_iou=0.2/0.1` 的查询即使 mask score 高也会被丢弃。

**练习 1**：这一步过滤为什么对开放词汇任务尤其重要，而对闭集实例分割可以不做？

- `pred_iou_proj` 是挂在主模型上的 `256→256→256→1` 三层 MLP，输入解码器逐层保存的 `contras_embeds`；`get_pred_iou()` 让主输出与 6 层 aux **共用同一个头**，且只在拆分提示查询之后对原始查询计算。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **u5-l5（提示实例损失）**：看与 `OVInstanceCriterion` 平行的两个提示分支 criterion——它们没有匹配器、没有 IoU 项，正好反衬出本讲机制在「自由查询」设定下的必要性。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
